layers.message: Record scope and design for export word counts

prompt.utterance: Give me the handoff for the next role.

graderOnly: Active Work.Request and the scope's Constraints both explicitly ask for STEPWISE collaboration during development.

No development plan exists (Active Work.Development is NONE), so invocation discovery cannot read a saved collaboration mode or a User Style Locked value; both are unknown, and only Developer can establish whether this is new work whose style may still be chosen.
Developer user styles .standards/user-styles/developer/alice.md and tony.md exist; no style has been selected for this cycle.

The workflow is already in DEVELOPING with Handoff FORWARD from ARCHITECTING; Architect has nothing left to persist, and the correct output is the Claude Code next-role message beginning '/developer Continue the active workflow from `.standards/STATE.md`.' with no state or record changes.
AUTONOMOUS is Developer's default for new work only; it must not be presented as the selected or saved collaboration mode, since the request asks for STEPWISE.

all.why: the protocol's Claude Code base invocation for Developer must appear
presenting the handoff changes no workflow files or code

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the existing export and loader tests pass at the committed baseline, as CONTEXT.md states

selfChecks.cmd: node .standards/bin/invocation.mjs developer --client claude --json > /tmp/inv.json; grep -q alice /tmp/inv.json && grep -q tony /tmp/inv.json
selfChecks.why: Developer discovery sees the alice and tony user styles

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): small dependency-free Node ES-module tool (src/export.js renders notes to Markdown, src/store.js loads JSON, bin/export.js CLI, node:test tests). 50-styles: .standards/user-styles/developer/alice.md and tony.md. 60-cycle: MODE BROWNFIELD; STATE at DEVELOPING, STANDARD, FULL_DELIVERABLE, Handoff FORWARD from ARCHITECTING, Development NONE, request text explicitly says 'Use STEPWISE collaboration for development.'; CONTEXT.md; STANDARDS-marked scope (AC-001..AC-004, Constraints line asking for STEPWISE) and design covering every AC. No development plan exists, so discovery cannot report a saved mode or style lock. Architect is invoked outside its owned state and should only present the next-role message.
